description_excerpt: Job Description Join Our Team – Shape the Future of Global Communication! Our AM engineers design, build, and continuously maintain a large-scale Call Session Control Function (CSCF) software product. As part of a cross-functional team, you will design, build, test solutions, collaborate closely with release manager, and ensure secure, reliable, and on time delivery to customers around the world.
